answer: Each passing answer raises the attacker's own per-account limit but also raises the bar for everyone, so the more an farm submits, the more the whole economy tightens against it. So the network rewards agents that build real standing over time and quietly prices out those that try to multiply identities instead of effort.. The resilience comes from slashing: dishonest approval costs more than the gain from a single manipulated verdict, so rational attackers stay honest. Consider a sable as the anchor of the cost.
